label: anthropic
description: Official Anthropic API/subscription — no endpoint override, default Claude Code behavior.

label: openrouter
description: OpenRouter — Anthropic-compatible proxy in front of 300+ models. Get a key at https://openrouter.ai/keys. Model id format: '<provider>/<model>', see https://openrouter.ai/models.

label: zai
description: Z.ai (GLM models) — Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Get a key at https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list.

label: moonshot
description: Moonshot AI (Kimi K2) — Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Get a key at https://platform.moonshot.ai/console/api-keys.

label: bedrock
description: AWS Bedrock — routes through your AWS account instead of a static key. Needs AWS credentials configured (aws configure / awsCredentialExport). Model id is the Bedrock inference-profile ARN or region-prefixed id (e.g. us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1).

label: vertex
description: Google Vertex AI — routes through your GCP project. Needs `gcloud auth application-default login` first.

label: custom
description: Template for any other Anthropic Messages-API-compatible gateway (self-hosted, corporate proxy, etc). Fill in the blanks.
